text:
irene (Design): Quick design review on Playground streaming UX. Main items: streaming visual (how tokens appear), primary action wording (Stop vs Interrupt vs Cancel), token counter placement during stream, and prompt library behavior while a generation is active. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc-playground

ben (Frontend): Proposal: small token pill anchored to the right rail (absolute) so main message flow doesn't reflow. While streaming show compact pill with count + tiny indeterminate ring. After finish expand into breakdown.

ahmed (Engineering): Sounds good. Note: we cancel the SSE on stop, no resume. So "Pause" is misleading. Prefer either "Stop generation" or "Interrupt". "Stop generation" is clearer for non-technical users.

mira (A11y): Accessibility: if we pick "Stop generation", the button needs aria-label that explains consequence: e.g. aria-label="Stop generation, partial response may be returned". Streaming chunks should be announced via aria-live="polite" with update coalescing to avoid spam.

tom (PM): On copy: would be nice to show a tiny helper under the button: "Stops generation. Partial response may be returned. Use Regenerate to restart." Keeps the button label simple and surfaces nuance.

ben (Frontend): Implementation notes: debounce token updates to ~200ms to reduce layout thrash. For the ring, use indeterminate unless model provides a length_hint. Also make the pill focusable and expose a tooltip: "Counts may update after stop."

ahmed (Engineering): Edge case: when we interrupt, backend might map to a fallback model and token counts can shift after post-processing. We'll log discrepancy and surface microcopy on the pill. Also ensure selecting a prompt mid-stream doesn't mutate current run.

irene (Design): UX for prompt library: allow browsing mid-stream but disable the "Apply" CTA with a small caption "Applies to next run". Keep library keyboard-accessible.

mira (A11y): Disabled apply button should still be focusable with aria-disabled="true" and an aria-describedby that points to the "applies to next run" note so screen reader users get context. Also ensure stop button remains first in tab order for fast access.

ben (Frontend): Will prototype pill + ring + tooltip + aria-live coalescing. Also add an in-app toast on stop: "Generation stopped — partial response returned." Toast will be aria-live polite and won't steal focus.

tom (PM): Action items: ben prototype by EOD Thu, mira to review a11y strings after prototype, ahmed to confirm cancel semantics with infra, irene to update Figma microcopy. ci-bot: queue staging deploy?

ci-bot: CI pipeline queued for branch playground/stream-ui -> staging at 2026-03-30 05:00 UTC

irene (Design): Thanks everyone. If a11y is clear I'll lock design and we can iterate on wording after testing.
